items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think it was Nick LaRocca told me about him.

ctx.x: Uh Tom? Yeah. I don't know. I don't know if Tom traveled.
I'm trying to remember. Somebody told me. I think it was Nick LaRocca told me about him. Maybe. Oh there's so many of them. Now uh what about Johnny Fisher? When did he get in Chicago?

I don't even know. He must have came after we left. Johnny was up there with me. He was playing with me up there. Did he come after we had gone? In 16. He was up there in 16? Yeah. You all uh you all left already for New York. You all left for New York.
